projects.name: SiteLab
projects.description: Multi-tenant AI platform turning client intake into a deployed Next.js site. Evolved from a Vercel + v0-SDK prototype into a production pnpm monorepo SaaS: client questionnaire app, operator backoffice, and three shared packages.

9+ durable workflows on Workflow DevKit: questionnaire -> RAG brief -> wireframes -> Next.js via V0 SDK -> preview -> publish
Vercel AI Gateway multi-provider routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) with AI cost tracking and generation analytics
Automated leadgen pipeline turning raw leads into generated sites; sites auto-deploy to <subdomain>.sitelab.build
Stripe billing (seat + metered usage) with multi-tenant model tiers for the Italian SMB market
Supabase Postgres with RLS on every table, pgvector, and generated types across 92 migrations

projects.name: PolyAgents
projects.description: Autonomous AI trading vault for Polymarket's BTC 5-minute binary markets, built for ETHGlobal Cannes 2026 (won the Hedera prize). A continuous loop discovers the market, asks an LLM for a directional call, places two-sided limit orders, and feeds outcomes back into a self-improving loop.
highlights: Rust workspace (6 crates) with an explicit 8-state engine
axum HTTP API + rmcp MCP server (18 tools) exposing the engine to agents and the Next.js dashboard
Passive market-making on the Polymarket CLOB with a lagged reconciler computing fill + PnL post-resolution
Self-improving layer (OpenClaw) that rewrites guidance from decision/outcome pairs for the next cycle
Three operating modes (simulator, demo with live CLOB orders, fully live) and AES-256-GCM per-vault key encryption
Polymarket CLOB/Gamma APIs, viem for on-chain USDC, Privy wallet auth, Terraform EC2 provisioning

projects.name: CraftLead
projects.description: AI-powered lead-intelligence platform for the Craftale web agency. Aggregates freelance and web-dev project postings from 12+ sources, scores them against a capability taxonomy, and drafts personalized outreach through an autonomous 4-agent swarm.
highlights: 4-agent swarm (Planner -> Researcher -> Critic -> Executor) with a confidence-gated feedback loop
12+ lead-source adapters (Upwork, LinkedIn, Web3.career and more) behind a unified match engine
OpenClaw agent orchestration over MCP, backed by a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway (Gemma 4 12B)
Typed inter-agent contract (PlannerTask / ResearchObservation / ExecutorReport) persisted to Supabase, with Langfuse tracing
Exposes its SDK as an MCP server so the same tools are callable from Claude, plus a credit system gating premium analysis

projects.name: Horizon

highlights: Stripe payment flow for voucher purchase, with Supabase edge functions driving fulfillment
AI form processing to structure customer intake
Client delivery with post-launch care (updates, backups, monitoring) on the agency's self-hosted stack

projects.name: Langfuse-OpenAI-Proxy
projects.description: A reverse proxy and observability gateway between an LLM app and any OpenAI-compatible backend (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama): per-request Langfuse tracing with per-project credential routing, zero changes to the calling app. Published on PyPI; deployable as a single Docker container.
highlights: Anthropic Messages API shim (/v1/messages) translating Claude's wire format to/from OpenAI, including streaming SSE with thinking/text/tool-use blocks
Deep Ollama reasoning-model support: native `think` routing, JSON-Schema sanitizer for llama.cpp grammars
Streaming guardrails: wall-clock cap under Cloudflare's 524 ceiling and an Ollama concurrency semaphore
SSRF-hardened host validation, path-traversal rejection, and shared-token auth on the Anthropic shim (fails closed)
Async FastAPI with detached Langfuse flush off the response path, plus real token-usage capture on early teardown

Privy embedded wallets for social login and account abstraction
MailProofs for domain and user verification with on-chain proof hashes
Patient claim verification and payouts via mailproofs
Insurer pools with yield via Aave

projects.name: Scaffold-Privy-AA
projects.description: Developer toolkit for Ethereum dapps with Privy social login and account abstraction, paired with Supabase for row-level security via a server-side token exchange. Next.js frontend, Foundry contracts, shadcn UI, and three branches: foundry, hardhat, supabase.
highlights: Privy-based social login and account abstraction (wallets + embedded)
Server Action verifies Privy JWT and mints short-lived Supabase-signed JWT for RLS
Contract hot-reload workflow with Foundry and frontend auto-adapting to contract changes
Prebuilt shadcn UI components and web3 hooks (wagmi/viem) for rapid development
